item.title: Day Zero Festival to debut in Bali this April with John Summit, Jamie Jones, Bonobo, Vintage Culture & more
item.description: Day Zero Festival has unveiled the full lineup for its Bali debut, with John Summit, Jamie Jones, Bonobo, Vintage Culture, Damian Lazarus and more set to headline the week-long ritual taking place from 14 – 19 April across the island. The centrepiece lands on 17 April at Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park, where the festival’s iconic sunset-to-sunrise ceremony will unfold against one of Bali’s most dramatic backdrops. item.title: Björn Again to bring 'The ABBA Forever Tour' to Singapore this August
item.description: Singapore, get ready to say ‘Gimme! Gimme! Gimme!’ all over again. Björn Again — widely regarded as the world’s number one ABBA tribute concert — is set to bring The ABBA Forever Tour to Sands Theatre at Marina Bay Sands from 14 to 16 August . Billed as a dazzling throwback to the disco heyday of 1979, the show promises a full-blown sing-along celebration packed with ABBA’s greatest anthems and soaring ballads. item.title: Wonderfruit makes international debut in Japan with Kyoto chapter this October
item.description: For the first time ever, Wonderfruit is stepping beyond Thailand.
